R821.note: Swaps mux for protectedHandler on the plaintext listener; both listeners now share the CSRF-wrapped handler, no other effect.

R822.note: Calls crypto.pbkdfSync(), which does not exist in Node's crypto module (real API is pbkdf2Sync); every request would throw and the endpoint would never encrypt anything.

R823.note: Removes the user-controlled Entity map entirely; Go's xml.Decoder is safe by default with no other behavior change.

R824.note: DynamicExpresso.Interpreter with only Total/Tax registered blocks reflection/file/process access while preserving the same JSON response shape.

R825.note: Removes the ignoringRequestMatchers exclusion, restoring CSRF only for the billing path; endpoint stays authenticated and returns the same result.

R826.note: Extension now comes from a fixed detected-type-to-extension map instead of the client filename; no other behavior change.

R827.note: Adds the missing length-vs-remaining-capacity check with correct overflow-safe ordering, exactly matching the stated contract.

R828.note: Replaces GroovyShell with Commons JEXL 3.3.1+, whose default RESTRICTED permissions block reflection/Runtime access; version floor correctly tied to that hardening.

R829.note: Parameterizes the EXEC call with @customerId; same proc, same result set, matches contract.

R830.note: Tika magic-byte check correctly replaces the trusted header, but the added ImageIO re-encode step silently alters/strips legitimate image bytes (metadata, quality) and can reject valid images ImageIO can't decode (e.g. CMYK JPEG) without calling this tradeoff out.

R831.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) overrides any client-supplied owner, standard DRF fix for the create-path gap.

R832.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() throws ArgumentNullException on null input; since orderId/note are unvalidated and can be null when the query param is omitted, a request that previously rendered an empty value now 500s, and this isn't mentioned.

R833.note: Allowlist regex removes all batch metacharacters from reportName before it reaches the concatenated Arguments string; closes the reported injection.

R834.note: password_verify() is the correct sink-level fix, but it only works once passwords are actually hashed; the write-up openly flags that password_hash() must be used on write but doesn't cover migrating already-stored plaintext rows, so existing accounts would fail login until that follow-up lands.

R835.note: Explicitly escapes CR/LF/control chars/line separators before logging and switches to parameterized logging; exception still attached, status codes untouched.

R836.note: Claims SLF4J's {} placeholders 'safely format' and sanitize input, but parameterized logging does not strip or escape newlines/control characters in the substituted value, so the log-forging vector reported by the scanner is not actually closed.

R837.note: Drops the attacker-controlled argsEnv parameter so exec runs with the inherited environment; removes the injection point with no other functional change to this benchmark handler.

R838.note: Replaces concatenation with a bound '?' placeholder; exact-match search behavior preserved as required.

R839.note: Extension allowlist plus Path.GetFileName() traversal check plus GUID-based naming closes both the dangerous-type and path-traversal angles; response shape preserved.

R840.note: Adds explicit HMAC method assertion in keyFunc plus WithValidMethods; closes the alg-confusion bypass without other side effects.

R841.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync auto-parameterizes accountId, status, and beforeUtc; same affected-row-count return, matches contract.

R842.note: Table name now checked against a fixed allowlist before interpolation; default ledger_entries and bound value params unaffected.

R843.note: Adds the missing getSessionIdentifier binding per csrf-csrf's own requirement; cookie settings and token flow otherwise unchanged.

R844.note: self.get_object() restores both queryset scoping and object-permission checks that get_object_or_404 bypassed; 404-vs-403 indistinguishability preserved for non-owners.

R845.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() wraps the __html value; strips scripts while preserving legitimate rich text formatting.

R846.note: Replaces seeded mt_rand with random_bytes/random_int, removing attacker control of the token entirely.

R847.note: Disables DOCTYPE/external entities/external DTD/XInclude on the factory before parsing; comprehensive, standard XXE hardening with no other observable change.

R848.note: The shown fix references an undefined Document type and a findById() method with no return statement (would not compile as written); it also never addresses the stated contract's no-enumeration requirement, since a non-owner now gets a distinguishable 403 rather than the existing not-found response.

R849.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to the actual HMAC algorithms the issuer signs with; no other configuration touched.

R850.note: Canonicalizes both base and target paths and verifies containment via startsWith with a separator suffix, closing traversal regardless of encoding tricks.

R851.note: Array-based exec closes injection for the Unix branch (/bin/ls is not a shell), but the Windows branch still spawns cmd.exe directly, which re-parses the reconstructed command line for its own metacharacters (&, |, etc.), leaving that path exploitable.

R852.note: Eliminates the OS command entirely in favor of Files.list(), removing the injection sink altogether.

R853.note: Adds the offset-vs-capacity and remaining-length checks in overflow-safe order, matching the stated contract exactly.

R854.note: Logs the detailed wrapped error server-side and returns a generic message to the client; standard, fully disclosed tradeoff.

R855.note: Adds .RequireAuthorization() to the previously-unprotected Minimal API route; no other behavior changed.

R856.note: Rejects any URI with a non-null host and any absolute opaque URI, allowing only relative local redirects; correctly blocks external and javascript:/data:-style targets.

R857.note: Adds secure=True (plus SameSite=Lax) to the cookie; directly closes the reported missing-Secure-attribute finding.

R858.note: Adds CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler, matching Spring's own documented fix for cookie-to-header SPA CSRF flows under the default Xor handler; keeps validation enforced while fixing the read/validate mismatch.

R859.note: Replaces str(e) with a fixed generic message and logs full detail server-side with exc_info; standard, complete fix.

R860.note: Replaces concatenation with a bound '?' parameter for the LIKE clause; wildcard placement and result behavior preserved.
